# google-classroom-student-mcp

> Free, open source, read only MCP server that lets AI apps (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot and others) read a student's Google Classroom courses, due dates, grades and announcements. It cannot submit, edit or delete anything.

## Setup
- Needs GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET and GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN.
- Run the one time login command from the README to get a refresh token.
- Run with npx -y google-classroom-student-mcp. Run `npx google-classroom-student-mcp doctor` to check the setup.

## Tools (all read only)
- get_my_courses
- get_todo
- get_upcoming_due_dates
- get_missing_assignments
- get_assignments
- get_my_grades
- get_announcements
- get_course_materials

get_todo, get_upcoming_due_dates, get_missing_assignments and get_my_grades take an optional course_ids list to check specific classes only. get_upcoming_due_dates also takes an optional days_ahead number. get_announcements takes optional course_ids too.

## Links
- Source and README, https://github.com/AnonymousOnyx22/google-classroom-student-mcp
- More free student MCP servers, https://brightspacemcp.com/more-mcps/
